author: D. D. Frederick
title: Former Illini golfers compete on PGA TOUR and Korn Ferry Tour
text:
Five former University of Illinois Fighting Illini men’s golf players are participating in professional tournaments this week, with representation on both the PGA TOUR and Korn Ferry Tour.
On the PGA TOUR, Adrien Dumont de Chassart is competing at the Cognizant Classic in The Palm Beaches. This event is held at the Champion Course at PGA National Golf Club in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida. Dumont de Chassart is making his fifth start of the 2025 season. He previously finished tied for 24th at the Sony Open and placed 69th at The American Express earlier this year. This will be his second appearance at The Cognizant Classic after missing the cut in his debut last year.
Meanwhile, four other former Illini—Jackson Buchanan, Michael Feagles, Luke Guthrie, and Nick Hardy—are playing in the 119 Visa Argentina Open on the Korn Ferry Tour. The tournament takes place at Jockey Club in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
For Buchanan, Feagles, and Hardy, this marks their fifth event of the season. Buchanan and Feagles are each seeking to make their third cut of the year while Hardy aims for his fourth made cut out of five events so far. Guthrie is starting his 2026 season with this tournament after finishing tied for 49th in last year’s edition.
Feagles currently stands at 77th on the Korn Ferry Tour points list. Hardy follows at 83rd position, Buchanan is ranked 101st, and Guthrie sits at 139th.
The University of Illinois Fighting Illini Men’s Golf program competes under NCAA Division I guidelines within the Big Ten Conference official website. The team participates in fall and spring tournaments that include conference and national competitions to provide student-athletes with opportunities for competitive experience official website. Led by head coach Mike Small official website, the program emphasizes team spirit and individual excellence while supporting academic achievement alongside athletic development official website.
